name: IGS Energy x ACM-W
desc: See how technology is shaping the future of energy with IGS Energy! Students will have the chance to ask questions, explore opportunities at IGS, and connect with professionals working at the intersection of technology, sustainability, and energy.

name: Mentorship Fall Craft Social
desc: Take a break and spend time with your mentorship group at our fall craft social. We'll have simple fall-themed crafts, snacks, and time to connect with other members in the mentorship program.

name: Brooksource Office Tour
desc: Step off campus and get an inside look at what working in tech is really like! Visit the Brooksource office for an exclusive opportunity to explore the workplace, meet industry professionals, learn about different career paths, and hear what companies look for when hiring early-career talent. Food and refreshments will be provided.
rsvp: RSVP here for ride to the venue:

name: Google Panel
desc: Ever wondered what it actually takes to land a role at Google? Hear directly from alumni who now work at Google as they share their journeys from OSU to one of the world’s leading tech companies. Learn what helped them stand out, get practical advice on technical and behavioral interviews, and gain insight into the recruiting process.

name: Smart Scheduling & Professor Recs Workshop
desc: Wondering what to schedule to next semester? Attend ACM-W's Smart Scheduling & Professor Recs Workshop to learn all the tips and tricks from upperclassmen about classes, professors, specializations, minors, and more!

name: Mentorship Information Meeting
desc: Join us for the ACM-W Mentorship Information Meeting! This event introduces interested students to our mentorship program, which pairs underclassmen with upperclassmen to help navigate computing at Ohio State. Whether you're looking for guidance on classes, advice on securing internships, or just want to connect with other students in tech, come learn how to get involved and meet your future mentor or mentee! We will have FREE pizza!!
rsvp: Click here to access interest form.

name: JP Morgan x ACM-W
desc: Get ready for recruiting season with ACM-W and JPMorgan Chase. JPMorgan Chase professionals will share practical advice for technical and behavioral interviews, building confidence, and standing out as a candidate. We'll wrap up with an open Q&A on JPMorgan Chase programs, internships, and full-time opportunities. Food will be provided.

name: Career Fair De-Stress Night
desc: Join ACM-W for a Career Fair De-Stress Social! We’ll start with a brief 10–15 minute check-in and career fair tips from fellow students, followed by an open social where you can choose from activities like tote bag painting, board and card games, working on resumes or applications, and casual conversations with peers.

name: Caterpillar Career Close-Up
desc: Come grab some food and see what engineering looks like beyond the classroom with Caterpillar! Learn how software, hardware, sensors, and autonomous technology come together to power massive real-world machines, explore different tech and engineering career paths, and chat with Caterpillar professionals about internships, careers, and life in industry.

name: Beyond LinkedIn Connections: Networking 101 with CapTech
desc: Starting your career journey is about more than just collecting LinkedIn connections, it is about building genuine relationships that can open doors. Join ACM-W at Ohio State and CapTech for our first company event of the season to learn how to network with confidence, make meaningful professional connections, and stand out in conversations with recruiters and industry professionals.
rsvp: Click here to RSVP to the event.

name: Fall Kickoff
desc: Come join ACM-W for our Fall Kickoff event to learn more about who we are, what we do, and how we support gender minorities in technology at Ohio State! We’ll introduce our executive board, share how we advocate for inclusive spaces in tech, and highlight opportunities to get involved in our mentorship program, professional devolpment opportunities and outreach. Hot pizza from Adriatico's will be served!

name: Ice Cream Social
desc: Join ACM-W for our first event of the year! Come meet fellow members, play light-hearted icebreaker games, and cool off with a scoop (or two) while learning more about our community and upcoming events.
